results.title: Leo — the Lantern Lion

Two large feathered wings in purple, blue and teal rise from its shoulders, one spread up behind the head and one behind the back. A small open book hangs on a cord at its chest; a lit golden lantern hangs from the curled tip of its tail at the right.
